content: LLM analytics advisors in SaaS use two patterns: (1) per-insight 'explain this' triggered on demand (side panel or inline expansion, streaming preferred to mask latency), and (2) whole-panel narrative cached per-org per-day. Streaming output via Server-Sent Events reduces perceived latency dramatically. Model selection: Claude Haiku/GPT-4o-mini for quick explanations (low cost, < 1s), Sonnet/GPT-4o for deep narratives (higher quality, cache aggressively). Amplitude Spark AI and Mixpanel Ask both answer natural-language 'why did X happen' questions anchored to deterministic data. The pattern is: deterministic engine produces facts → LLM produces the narrative around those facts. Caching per-org/day is the dominant cost-control strategy; cache writes cost ~25% premium, cache reads cost 10% of base (Anthropic prompt caching). Break-even at 2+ reads per cached prefix.
